title: Motion tests run only in the local CI mirror; GitHub CI never executes `odin test app/render`
evidence:
.github/workflows/ci.yml:69-70:
      - name: Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)
        run: odin test core

tools/ci-local.sh:56:
  "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && for i in 1 2 3; do odin test app -out:bin/app-test || exit 1; done && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test app/audio -out:bin/audio-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test"

tools/ci-local.sh:8-9 (header):
# The gate list mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml step-for-step — the workflow
# is the spec; never edit one without the other.

_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/packet-plumber-v2-motion-readability/README.md:66:
`app/render/motion_test.odin` (13 new `@(test)`s, in the gate-2 render test
detail: The r1-B1/B2 fix's only automated guard (the interp pins — the golden gates never execute alpha<1) runs solely via ci-local.sh gate 2; the workflow, which the local script's own header calls the spec, runs only `odin test core`. GH CI compiles but never runs motion_test.odin.
recommended_fix: Add `odin test app && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test app/audio && odin test harness` to ci.yml's unit-test step, restoring the parity ci-local.sh's header promises (pre-existing gap this diff's claim rests on).

title: N15 deferral's safety claim is inverted: drift in the strip's orchestration copy cannot fail `harness run`
evidence:
_bmad-output/pr-bodies/v2-motion-readability.md:91-94:
  T1-pinned golden — so a drift in the strip driver would fail `harness
  run` (the blessed manifest) before it could mislead a measurement.

harness/motion_strip.odin:22-23:
// pure function of the wall ms. T1 manifest + replay gate are NOT re-verified
// here (run_demo does that) — this verb is a RENDER-ONLY evidence tool; it

harness/motion_strip.odin:62-81 (the copy):
	state: pp.Run_State
	defer pp.run_destroy(&state)
	pp.run_init(&state, demo.seed, cat.hash, cat.balance.logic_hz)
	state.era = demo.era
	cfg := Demo_Replay{
detail: `harness run` exercises run_demo, not this copy. If run_demo later gains a setup piece the copy misses, the manifest stays green while the strip silently renders a diverged timeline — exactly the failure the rationale claims is impossible.
recommended_fix: Keep the refactor deferral, but make the claim true: in run_motion_strip, compare each stepped tick's `pp.state_hash` against the demo's blessed .t1 and exit 2 on mismatch.

title: Packet body color restated as a hardcoded constant in the measurement tool
evidence:
tools/measure_packet_motion.py:27:
BODY = (90, 98, 112)  # email packet body color (data/packet_types.json)

data/packet_types.json:7:
      "color_rgba": [90, 98, 112, 255],
detail: Violates the ODN-5 single-source convention in spirit; a palette change (this series just survived one) makes every frame print 'lost' instead of failing loud.
recommended_fix: Read email's color_rgba from data/packet_types.json (or accept a --body r,g,b flag) instead of the restated constant.
